clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Narache, young tauren receive the Totem of Hawkwind before departing for Bloodhoof Village. They present it to Baine Bloodhoof as proof that they have completed their first trials and are ready to continue the Rites of the Earthmother.

Chief Hawkwind carves the Totem of Hawkwind atop Red Cloud Mesa for youth coming of age. The token introduces its bearer and proves their passage. Tauren rarely use formal writ; meaningful symbols and familiar tribal craft carry a leader's intent. After a youth completes the first trials at Camp Narache, Hawkwind sends them onward with the totem, along the road into the wider lands of Mulgore. Its distinct carvings identify the bearer to Baine Bloodhoof and show they have the spirit and strength for the next trials, on the way to seeking the blessing of Thunder Bluff.
